7418.title: Busy accounts cannot refresh obsolete quota windows
7418.rootCauseOneLine: The usage-refresh busy-account guard starves authoritative quota updates, including forced refreshes, while partial headers preserve older windows.
7418.proposedFix: Remove the in-flight refresh guard while retaining refresh single-flight and interval throttling; protect the behavior with a real-plugin streaming CLI regression.
7418.caveats: Synthetic provider transport; no live provider-side limit removal or browser render was tested. The same agent reproduced the regression in two clean trusted checkouts. Reproduction code and output are inline under reports repository policy.
